summary: This change introduces a data migration and a new validation path. Risk is high: the migration drops a column still read at runtime, which will break existing batches. One blocker and one high issue were found, so the change is not approvable as-is.

findings.message: DROP COLUMN legacy_stage removes a column still read in process-plan.ts; add a backfill and code change first or the read throws.
Stabilization is scheduled before fermentation completes when residual sugar is above threshold, violating the documented process ordering.
